      "text": "The dish of bacon and brains is made in this manner [2] strain [or chop fine] {{ing_01|hard boiled eggs}} [3] with {{ing_02|parboiled brains}} [calf’s or pig’s] the skin and nerves of which have been removed; also cook {{ing_03|chicken giblets}}, all in proportion to the fish [4] put this aforesaid mixture in a saucepan, place the {{ing_04|cooked bacon}} in the center, grind {{ing_05|pepper}} and {{ing_06|lovage}} and to sweeten add {{ing_07|a dash of mead}}, heat, when hot stir briskly with a {{ing_08|rue whip}} and bind with {{ing_09|roux}}."
